record.question: EDTA typically preserves cellular morphology for:
record.explanation: Official final key: C — 12-24 hours. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 7, printed Q37. Source limitation: “Typically” gives no specimen storage temperature, analyzer/lab conditions, or definition of acceptable morphology, so an exact duration is not supportable. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
